title: Rippers — Combat Dock
description: A faction-centric combat dock for Project FU: allies and enemies as portrait-card ribbons around a round totem. FU has no initiative queue — clicking a card selects the actor and chooses the turn; turn-end routes through the system's own end-turn path. Enemy vitals stay veiled until Studied (7+ reveals HP/MP), staggered enemies wear their turn-loss openly, and the dock opens and closes with combat, collapsing any live party HUD while it holds the top of the screen.
